collab.common_error: At selected O compute each member Hits50 success against its own complete100000negative50th-score threshold and the pool against its own threshold. Fixed common-miss cohort = all4members miss AND O pool miss. All-member misses alone do not guarantee pool miss because negative thresholds/orderings differ.
collab.cotangent: For one view and group weight w_i=1/n_pos or1/n_neg: w_i/4 * [(1-lambda)(sigmoid(z_mi)-y_i)+lambda(sigmoid(mean_j z_ji)-y_i)]. Two-view average adds factor1/2.
collab.mechanism: Every member receives the SAME pool residual; member Jacobians can differ. No node-dependent winning-member probability-credit claim.
collab.member_readout: All4 member Hits50 and group-sum BCE, pooled Hits50 and same-reduction BCE; negative-score threshold/rank diagnostics labelled secondary
collab.negative_contract: Unchanged TRAIN-only PyG negative_sampling on both-direction historical support, same requested count/source runtime/random protocol; no future-positive rejection. Freeze/record seed-epoch negative and query-order hashes across paired arms before inspecting outcomes. Preserve every positive target, full tail, and removal of all duplicate target records in both directions from TRAIN support.
collab.net_repair: On ALL60084 positive targets: O pool miss->I hit, O hit->I miss, both hit/miss; net/60084 equals Hits50 difference. Recompute each state official negative threshold with original strict tie convention; report the O-defined cohort separately.
collab.own: Per member BCE_positive.mean() PLUS BCE_negative.mean(), then mean over4members. No factor1/2; not mean over concatenated labels.
collab.pool: BCEWithLogits(mean_m z_m, y)_positive.mean() PLUS _negative.mean(); same group weights even if group sizes differ
collab.selection_caveat: No local transition. With identical own-only trajectories, packed/ordinary contrast isolates checkpoint selection; actual source/data/RNG equivalence must be established before result reuse.

statistical_scope.confirmation: Root must predeclare ONE primary contrast before any outcomes. Other contrasts are attribution diagnostics unless included in the prespecified confirmatory family.
statistical_scope.development: Three paired seed blocks are descriptive/exploratory. Show every block and paired seed uncertainty; no numerical uncertainty calculation performed here.
statistical_scope.model_replicate_unit: Paired independently initialized optimizer seed block within this fixed source/split. Nodes, edges, molecules and positive-negative pairs inside one split are NOT independent model replicates.
statistical_scope.multiplicity: Any confirmatory claim spanning multiple tasks or contrasts requires a frozen hypothesis family, error level and multiplicity procedure before outcomes; no separate unadjusted success claims after inspecting all cells.
statistical_scope.population_limit: One fixed dataset/split per task; optimizer-seed repeatability and finite-population repair accounting do not imply graph-population significance. Same VALID selector is not a new independent held-out test.
